separate_assertions: keyboard activation with Enter and Space
failure_condition: A div styled as an action lacks native button semantics and keyboard activation.
expected_outcome: The control variant exposes a named button and works with keyboard activation.
manual_verification_method: Test keyboard activation and inspect the computed role and name.
dom_testability: Can inspect native element and explicit role, but cannot establish operation without interaction.
accessibility_tree_testability: Can inspect computed role and name; keyboard behavior requires interaction.
limitations: Name/role/value and keyboard operability are separate assertions and must be reported separately.
